description:
Ultra Nova is a team that brings leadership, tech, coding, SI, and team work skills into the group. We share an idea of making a game, then making it reality.

Elon - Team Lead/ Code Lead

Using coding and AI to build the simulation.

Justin - Source Officer

Search through NASA data to set up the Code Lead.

Ethan - Helper

Joined very late but was able to contribute.

Ryan - Image and Planner

Make most of the images in the game and plan the entire schedule.
